name: prebase-extension
description: PreBase: codebase architecture Network and Temporal graphs for VS Code

scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:webview && npm run build:extension
scripts.build:engine: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target cargo build --release -p prebase-engine && node scripts/copy-engine.mjs
scripts.build:engine:debug: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target cargo build -p prebase-engine && node scripts/copy-engine.mjs --debug
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:extension && npm run test:webview
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w extension && npm run typecheck -w webview
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w extension && npm run inspect-vsix
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run package
